files.description: Weekly unit sales (144 rows): region (north, south or west), channel (online, store or kiosk; the west region has no kiosk, so that pair never occurs), week (week number 1-18), units (whole number; about 2% empty).

task_text: For every combination of region (north, south, west) and channel (online, store, kiosk), including combinations with no sales rows at all, tell whether any week had more than 50 units; a combination without rows has no such week. Treat region and channel as categories with these fixed values. `result` should be a Series of True/False indexed by region and channel.
intended_computation: For all 9 (region, channel) combinations return True if some week has units > 50, else False (west-kiosk: False).

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the applied function leaves the combination without rows out; 3.x lists it with False

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
